selectionReason: Both top-two methods passed 8/8 development tasks under both reviewers. Keyword search is the simpler default. Dense search is a prospective additional-method comparison, not a preselected winner.
acceptance: At least two additional independent cases passing in both repetitions versus direct under both fixed-criterion reviewers, and at least two more passes per repetition, with no new prerequisite/authority/runtime-proof regression. Repeats are not independent tasks. Adopt the semantic dependency only with at least two additional stable cases over the simpler lexical method under both reviewers and no new safety regressions. No source, prompt, cutoff or generation-profile changes after opening holdout inputs.
limits: Synthetic context-use cohort, not arithmetic, human UAT or production-path integration. Embedding responses report a configured tag; installed artifact digest is independently checked. The comparison matches original evidence availability and generation settings; selected context differs by treatment. It does not prove wrapper superiority with manually identical selected excerpts.
